cluster_label: testis_secretory cell of the male reproductive tract
working_definition: Generic secretory cell group of the adult male reproductive tract (found in male reproductive glands and testis analyses); no FBbt id given by authors.
searches_performed: semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system

best_match.fbbt_term: semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system
best_match.fbbt_definition: Any cell of the male reproductive system that contributes to the production and secretion of seminal fluid proteins. This includes cells of the accessory glands as well as cells of the seminal vesicles and the ejaculatory bulb (Suarez and Wolfner, 2017).

justification: The label names secretory cells of the male reproductive tract generically; FBbt's semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system is the corresponding cell class and parent of accessory gland main/secondary cells.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: semen-secreting cell of the male accessory gland
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system that is part of some male accessory gland.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too specific; cluster not restricted to accessory gland.

recommendation: Accept; curator may confirm that 'semen-secreting' equates to the authors' generic 'secretory'.
